svg.title: Proposed rules ownership — not implemented in the game
svg.desc: No JS handles cross worker boundaries. No JavaScript, allocation or GC in the audio callback.

g.text: Proposed rules ownership — not implemented in the game
Owns air state, recent history, combo, meter and persistence; captures immutable input.
Receives copied data; temporary G.recent is reset for each call; returns pts/name/ubers.
Reject malformed, stale or failed output before effects; native appends accepted history once.
Terrain + World remain collision/render authority; GL main thread; audio receives numeric commands.
No JS handles cross worker boundaries. No JavaScript, allocation or GC in the audio callback.
